# Ayr Heating & Cooling

> Ayr Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Ayr, Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 632-8174  |  Email: contact@ayrheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ayrheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ayr, Brantford, Paris, Caledonia, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Aylmer
